title: Step 3c - Plotting the Elbow Method Graph for K-Means Clustering in Python

cues.en: Instructor: So here we just have to plot the graph.
cues.zh: 講師：這裡只要把圖畫出來。

cues.en: And to do this, well, we're gonna use, of course, matplotlib.pyplot, which we will use this way first by calling the plt shortcut here
cues.zh: 當然要使用 matplotlib.pyplot，先呼叫這裡的 plt 簡稱，

cues.en: and then from which we're gonna call the plot function.
cues.zh: 接著從中呼叫 plot 函式。

cues.en: This is something we already did of course when plotting our regression curves or classification curves in part two and three.
cues.zh: 第二和第三部分畫迴歸曲線或分類曲線時，我們當然已經做過這件事。

cues.en: And now we are about to plot just a simple curve that will follow the different WCSS values taken for the different numbers of clusters from one to 10.
cues.zh: 現在只要畫一條簡單曲線，呈現群組數量從 1 到 10 時，各自對應的 WCSS 值。

cues.en: And so well, in that plot function, remember what we have to input.
cues.zh: 記得 plot 函式裡要輸入什麼嗎？

cues.en: First, we have to input the different values that will be taken on the x-axis and that's the values from one to 10.
cues.zh: 首先要輸入 X 軸上的各個值，也就是 1 到 10。

cues.en: So in order to specify this, well, we can simply take that range again, because that range from one to 10 exactly returns all the values from one to 10.
cues.zh: 要指定這些值，直接再用剛才的 range 就好，因為那個從 1 到 10 的範圍，正好會傳回 1 到 10 的所有值。

cues.en: So there you go.
cues.zh: 就是這樣。

cues.en: That's what we can input here for the x-coordinates.
cues.zh: 這就是這裡 X 座標的輸入。

cues.en: And now for the y-coordinates, according to what are we going to input here, well, very simply, that's of course all the different values of WCSS and they have to be input in a list.
cues.zh: 至於 Y 座標，你覺得要輸入什麼？很簡單，當然就是所有不同的 WCSS 值，而且要放在串列裡輸入。

cues.en: And well, good news, that's exactly what we have already and that's of course also the reason why we created that list in the first place
cues.zh: 好消息是，我們已經有了；這當然也是一開始建立這個串列的原因，

cues.en: so that we can directly input this into the plot function to indeed plot our elbow method graph.
cues.zh: 讓我們可以直接把它傳入 plot 函式，畫出手肘法圖表。

cues.en: All right, things are starting to get completed here.
cues.zh: 好，這裡快完成了。

cues.en: Now what else can we do to improve that graph?
cues.zh: 還能做什麼來改善圖表？

cues.en: Well, you know very simply, we're gonna add a nice title with the title function and we'll actually title our graph by the elbow method.
cues.zh: 很簡單，使用 title 函式加上漂亮的標題，就把圖表命名為「手肘法」。

cues.en: All right, very simply.
cues.zh: 好，很簡單。

cues.en: Then we'll add a label to the x-axis, thanks to the xlabel function.
cues.zh: 接著用 xlabel 函式加上 X 軸標籤。

cues.en: And on the x-axis, we can specify that it is indeed the number of clusters.
cues.zh: X 軸可以標示它代表群組數量。

cues.en: Perfect, and now same for the ylabel which we will specify to be, of course, the WCSS
cues.zh: 很好，ylabel 也一樣，當然設定為 WCSS，

cues.en: within cluster sum of squares.
cues.zh: 也就是群內平方和。

cues.en: And finally, remember the last thing we have to do which is to show the graph with the show function.
cues.zh: 最後，記得還要用 show 函式顯示圖表。

cues.en: All right, so I think we're done here.
cues.zh: 好，我想這裡完成了。

cues.en: Let's see, let's see if we're right and if we didn't make any mistake.
cues.zh: 來看看是否正確，有沒有出錯。

cues.en: So we're actually going to play that cell and plot the elbow method graph.
cues.zh: 執行這個儲存格，畫出手肘法圖表。

cues.en: Congratulations, we did it 100% correctly.
cues.zh: 恭喜，我們百分之百做對了。

cues.en: So now, according to you, after you've followed the intuition lectures, what is the optimal number of clusters we must choose here?
cues.zh: 看過概念課之後，你覺得這裡應該選擇的最佳群組數量是多少？

cues.en: Well, I remind that this is the number of clusters from which the WCSS value starts slowing down, starts reducing its distance.
cues.zh: 提醒一下，就是從哪個群組數量開始，WCSS 的下降速度放緩，下降幅度縮小。

cues.en: And here, well, that's of course that number here, the number five because indeed from this number, well, you know the curve starts being almost flat.
cues.zh: 這裡當然就是這個數字，5，因為從這裡開始，曲線幾乎變平。

cues.en: It decreases very slowly here.
cues.zh: 它在這裡下降得很慢。

cues.en: It decreases very strongly.
cues.zh: 這裡下降得很劇烈。

cues.en: It decreases a lot.
cues.zh: 降幅很大。

cues.en: Here, still quite much.
cues.zh: 這裡還是降得不少。

cues.en: And from the number of clusters five, well, it decreases slowly, okay?
cues.zh: 從群組數量 5 開始，就下降得很慢，好嗎？

cues.en: So clearly the optimal number of classes here is five.
cues.zh: 所以這裡最佳的群組數量顯然是 5。

cues.en: And therefore, for our next step showing in K-means model on the dataset, we will choose to build it, to train it, and to run it to identify five clusters.
cues.zh: 因此，下一步用資料集訓練 K-means 模型時，我們會建立、訓練並執行它，來辨識五個群組。

cues.en: All right, so let's do this in a next tutorial.
cues.zh: 好，下一堂就來做。

cues.en: And actually, I have an exercise for you based on what we did here to plot that elbow method graph.
cues.zh: 而且根據這裡畫手肘法圖表的做法，我有一個練習要給你。

cues.en: You can actually totally do this on your own.
cues.zh: 你其實完全能自己做。

cues.en: So actually in the next tutorial, we will train that K-means model on the dataset to identify five clusters, and then we'll also create that dependent variable
cues.zh: 所以下一堂會用資料集訓練 K-means 模型，辨識五個群組，接著也會建立那個應變數，

cues.en: which I've told you about.
cues.zh: 就是之前提過的。

cues.en: That's the principle of clustering.
cues.zh: 這就是分群的原理。
